title: Display apps with multiple streams as a single item, rather than showing one item per stream
line: The Audio Volume applet now shows an app that plays several streams as one item with one slider, which can be expanded to show each stream.
explanation: The Applications page of the Audio Volume applet listed every playback and recording stream on its own, so an app like Firefox with three tabs playing showed three items, and changing the app's volume meant moving three sliders. Now the stream lists show only the first stream of each application (by client name); when the app has more streams, that item becomes the app's item: it shows just the app name, its slider and mute button act on all of its streams, it shows the loudest stream's volume and is muted only when all of them are, and dragging it to a device or picking a device in its menu moves all of them. An arrow button next to the menu expands it to show each stream with its own controls, as suggested in comment 2.

commits.message:
applet: show the streams of an application as one item

Apps that play several streams at once got one slider per stream, so
changing an app's volume meant moving each of them. Streams are now
grouped by application, and the group can be expanded to show each one.
